html: The 2027 plan is out: parking is free at every show, and the shuttle bus from Biggleswade station is £10 return. The parking, shuttle and ticket details below are from Shuttleworth’s 2027 event pages. I would still suggest checking everything again nearer your show, as times can change. New parking arrangements to meet Martyn's Law. On show days you’ll need to use the Alder Drive entrance only, so it’s worth putting that in your sat nav. The Hill Lane entrance is for daily admission, and access through Old Warden village and the estate isn't allowed on event days. Shuttleworth's getting here page ↗
